quality: Branch, tags and deploys are protected with no bypass, secret files cannot be pushed, access stays inside the organization, and every secret is used.
speed: No rule waits for a person or a timer, and dependency updates arrive grouped.
consumption: No setting bills past what the plan includes unless it was bought on purpose.

parts.ideal: One merge method, auto-merge off, merged branches deleted, no wiki, forking off for a private repo
parts.setup: Set them once on the General page, then name the values in the repo's targets so drift is counted

parts.ideal: Members only via the org: no outside collaborator, invite or custom role. A public repo gates fork runs, takes private reports, blocks secrets, has Discussions
parts.setup: Organization base permission read, two-factor required; invite people to the organization, not the repo; a public repo's four settings are one gh api call each (templates/open/README.md)

parts.ideal: Rulesets: a pull request and a passing check to merge, no force push, deletion or bypass, tags fixed; custom properties only to target rulesets
parts.setup: An organization ruleset for every default branch; repo rulesets for checks, tags and secret file names

parts.ideal: Only selected actions, pinned to a commit, a read-only token, no fork runs; each webhook has a secret and checks SSL
parts.setup: Actions page: policies and workflow permissions, scored on the Security and Actions tabs; add a webhook only with a secret

parts.ideal: Copilot review and Codespaces off unless bought: both bill by use; issue types and fields set once for the organization
parts.setup: Leave both off; planning lives in organization settings and is scored on the Issues and Projects tabs

parts.ideal: Each environment deploys from named branches only, with no reviewer or timer; Pages is private, built by a workflow, over HTTPS
parts.setup: Environment page: selected branches and tags; Pages page: source GitHub Actions, visibility private

parts.ideal: Free features on: dependency graph, Dependabot alerts and security updates; no deploy key; every stored secret read by a workflow
parts.setup: One organization security configuration; paid scanning only when bought; delete a secret when its workflow goes

parts.ideal: Only apps the organization uses, each with the permissions it needs; autolinks only for a tracker outside GitHub
parts.setup: Review installed apps on the organization's GitHub Apps page; add one autolink per outside ticket prefix
